Author: CrownedPandaXIV
Name: XIV Fleet Companion
Description:
Got a massive fleet of submarines? Always struggling to see which ones need upgrades? Wanna see your multi-account fleet at a glance? Give this a try!

Subs and their routes, supplies, parts, retainers, Free Companies, inventories, income, the market and trends, all in the game. Keep your fleet on this PC with nothing else to install, or share it between PCs (and with the free Windows app) through a database. Type /xivfleet to start.

Needs:
• AutoRetainer (from https://love.puni.sh/ment.json)

Works best with:
• Allagan Tools: bags, retainers' items and FC chests
• FC Tracker (from https://puni.sh/api/repository/erdelf): FC houses
• Submarine Tracker: voyage loot

Thanks to kawaii, NightmareXIV and the Puni.sh team (AutoRetainer), Critical_Impact (Allagan Tools), erdelf (FC Tracker) and Infi (Submarine Tracker) for their plugins.
Punchline: Here to help manage your EMPIAH!
Changelog:
### Changed
- Levelling Plan: the fewest days. Part swaps are now judged by how much sooner the whole plan reaches the target, both on the route being run and on the best route the new part allows (a part that opens a better route was missed before), with no cap on how many. Several parts can change at the same rank.
- Levelling Plan with a Free Company's sectors: sectors open on the way. Each voyage through a sector has a chance to open each sector it leads to (25% to start with, from Pepper's guide; change it on the page), and the plan counts on the expected number of voyages. Stages say what they're expected to open, and when a stage goes out of its way to open a better sector.
- Hovering a sector letter shows its name, map and rank (Levelling Plan, Route Finder, Compare Builds).
- Levelling Plan, easier to read: "Not discovered yet" says when the plan opens a sector itself ("H opens on the way, by rank 97") instead of what it would add; a stage that doesn't reach the next rank shows its one rank ("96", not "96 → 96"); and the day strip labels only the stages with room, with the days under it where the stages end and never crowded (every stage's ranks and days on hover).
